note: Phase-3 frozen. Analogous gold types to C1–C4/U1–U4 with new surface wording. Not merged into data/cases.json. Frozen A–D; B′ not default.

cases.why: Morning plan says first-line failed and switch; same-day late note says continue first-line with stability.
cases.evidence: AM oncology: first-line FOLFOX has failed; start second-line FOLFIRI this week. PM addendum the same calendar day: CT today shows stable disease on first-line FOLFOX; continue current regimen, no switch.

cases.why: One note denies any chemo; a later note describes completed first-line cycles then progression.
cases.evidence: ED triage: patient reports never having chemotherapy. Medical oncology follow-up: completed six cycles of first-line gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel, then radiographic progression in the liver.

cases.why: Outside letter asserts first-line failure; local review says systemic first-line was never given.
cases.evidence: Outside consultation letter: failed first-line systemic therapy, referred for next-line options. Internal chart review: no first-line systemic therapy was administered here or elsewhere; treatment to date is best supportive care only.

cases.why: Same named first-line regimen described as progressed and as excellent ongoing response. Gold stays CONTRADICTION (identity/time class); do not retune after seeing models.
cases.evidence: Interval note: progression on first-line palbociclib plus letrozole. Subsequent clinic note: excellent ongoing response to first-line palbociclib plus letrozole; continue current treatment.

cases.why: Possible progression on first-line; confirmatory imaging not yet done.
cases.evidence: Possible progression on first-line sunitinib; MRI pending next Thursday before any regimen change.

cases.why: Possible prior therapy at another site; administration and outcome unknown.
cases.evidence: Family states the patient may have received immunotherapy at an outside clinic last year. No records transferred. Whether that treatment was given, and how it went, is unknown.

cases.why: Mixed radiographic findings; no clear fail/continue decision yet.
cases.evidence: On first-line R-CHOP. Mixed response: mediastinal nodes smaller, new questionable splenic lesions. Plan deferred until lymphoma conference.

cases.why: Unresolved whether the named drug was metastatic first-line or adjuvant; no clear progression.
cases.evidence: Unclear from the scanned notes whether oxaliplatin was given as first-line therapy for metastatic disease or as adjuvant treatment after resection. No definite progression is documented.
